20261024T220300Z-probes-95164128.interpretation: Exploratory probes. P1 units are synthetic feedback templates; P2 units are independent stateless calls. Synthetic feedback is an experimenter manipulation, not observed play. P2 matches awareness and changes only the authorization sentence; it measures sender dependence, not receiver use, profit or intent.

20261024T222603Z-restraint-71e0e24f.interpretation: Exploratory probes. Units are independent stateless calls (D, R) or synthetic templates (F). Encoding differences use raw point estimates with Agresti-Caffo adjusted variances. Primary: three main effects in the no-thinking factorial, Bonferroni z=2.394; equivalence margin 0.15. End-to-end gain combines separately sampled sender and receiver policies; it is not observed pair play.
